changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.10
changeSet.comment: nexus.plain_search_384/768/1024 and nexus.text_gated_search_{hnsw_first,by_chash}_384/768/1024: the liveness filter becomes live(c), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)), replacing the vectors-017-1 dead-set anti-join. A chunk with no live owner in its own collection, a manifest-less chunk included, is no longer returned (RDR-192 Gap 1). Bodies otherwise unchanged.

changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.10
changeSet.comment: nexus.hybrid_search_384/768/1024: the gate CTE's liveness filter becomes live(c), replacing the vectors-017-2 dead-set anti-join, so the unused-in-production parity function keeps the same definition of liveness as the routed search functions. Bodies otherwise unchanged.

changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.10
changeSet.comment: nexus.search_topic_scoped_384/768/1024: the liveness filter becomes live(c), replacing the vectors-016-1 tenant-wide manifest-less-is-live check. A chunk with no live owner in its own collection is no longer returned. Bodies otherwise unchanged.

changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.10
changeSet.comment: nexus.live_chunks: the WHERE clause becomes live(c), so the view is scoped per (collection, chash) and a manifest-less chunk is not live (RDR-192 Gaps 1 and 5). The column list is unchanged (the embedding cast is schema-qualified as nexus.vector, the same type vectors-005-1's bare ::vector resolved to), so CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW keeps the dependent nexus.collection_vector_stats and the PUBLIC grant; collection_vector_stats now counts per collection.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.live_chunks WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash, c.chunk_text, COALESCE(c.embedding_384, c.embedding_768, c.embedding_1024)::nexus.vector AS embedding, c.chunk_tsv, c.metadata, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash));

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.live_chunks WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash, c.chunk_text, COALESCE(c.embedding_384, c.embedding_768, c.embedding_1024)::nexus.vector AS embedding, c.chunk_tsv, c.metadata, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE (NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND m.chash = c.chash )) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND m.chash = c.chash AND d.deleted_at IS NULL );

changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.10
changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_vector_stats becomes the collection inventory with a live count (RDR-192 Step 5 amendment, Sam 2026-09-27: split inventory from liveness): one row per (tenant, collection, dim) that physically holds chunks, read from nexus.chunks rather than nexus.live_chunks; chunk_count and last_write count only live(c) chunks and may be 0 and null; a new last column, stored_count, counts every stored chunk. A collection whose chunks are all unowned (a quarantine sibling, a first chunk written before its manifest) keeps its row, so list_collections, get_collection, census --all and the ghost sweep's dormant check still see it. The five existing columns keep their names and types; stored_count is appended, so the rollback drops and recreates the view.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash))) AS chunk_count, max(c.created_at) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash))) AS last_write, count(*) AS stored_count FROM nexus.chunks c GROUP BY c.tenant_id, c.collection, 3;

rollback.sql: DROP VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT lc.tenant_id, lc.collection, lc.dim, count(*) AS chunk_count, max(lc.created_at) AS last_write FROM nexus.live_chunks lc GROUP BY lc.tenant_id, lc.collection, lc.dim; GRANT SELECT ON nexus.collection_vector_stats TO PUBLIC;
